title: Dependency advisory exceptions
objective: Remove or re-review the two temporary advisory exceptions before they expire.
context_summary: The dependency audit tolerates two maintenance advisories in the pinned Iced and Metal stacks, each with a UTC expiry and an open task here. The audit fails when an exception expires or its task is retired.

tasks.description: Remove or re-review the temporary ttf-parser maintenance exception before 2026-10-29.
extra_context: RUSTSEC-2026-0192 on ttf-parser 0.25.1 via fontdb 0.23 in the Iced text stack (and ab_glyph in winit's Wayland decorations on Linux), last reviewed 2026-09-29 and expiring exclusively on 2026-10-29 (UTC), as `exceptions()` in xtask/src/policy.rs records. At that review fontdb 0.24.0 had dropped ttf-parser and cosmic-text main had adopted it, but no cosmic-text or Iced release used it, and the upstream denial-of-service report was still undisclosed and unfixed. The audit wrapper enforces the expiry, the exact resolved version and registry source, a review window of at most 90 days and that this task stays open. Review sooner for new security information, a cosmic-text or Iced release that adopts fontdb 0.24, distribution or font-input scope changes.

acceptance_criteria: Check supported upstream releases and remove ttf-parser when a compatible migration is available.

steps: Inspect current upstream releases and exact configured dependency graph.
Verify expiry, audit and relevant runtime checks.
expected_results: No stale, permanent or broad advisory suppression remains.

tasks.description: Remove or re-review the temporary paste maintenance exception before 2026-12-18.
extra_context: RUSTSEC-2024-0436 on paste 1.0.15, a build-time proc macro reached through metal and wgpu-hal, reviewed 2026-09-19 and expiring exclusively on 2026-12-18 (UTC), as `exceptions()` in xtask/src/policy.rs records. The audit wrapper enforces the expiry, the exact resolved version and registry source, a review window of at most 90 days and that this task stays open. Review sooner for new security information or a change to the pinned Iced, wgpu or Metal stack.
